project_type: Full-stack hospitality guest-intelligence platform. Frontend: Next.js 14 (app router) + Tailwind + TypeScript + Vitest. Backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11). This task is frontend-only (UI/UX redesign); backend is NOT touched but its test gate must stay green.
build_system: npm (frontend) + uv (backend). Node is NOT on the default PATH in this sandbox: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" before running npm/npx. Node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2.
test_framework: Vitest (frontend, jsdom + @testing-library/react) in *.test.tsx; pytest (backend). ESLint via next lint.
build_command: cd frontend && npm run build  (currently 22 routes incl /login; expect route count to change when a landing route is added)
test_command: frontend: cd frontend && npx vitest run (24 passing) + npm run lint (clean). backend: cd backend && uv run pytest (255 passing) + uv run ruff check . (clean). ALL FOUR must stay green.
verification_instructions: After each feature: run `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run`, and `npm run build` from frontend/ with node on PATH. Backend `uv run pytest` + `uv run ruff check .` must remain green (not expected to change since this is frontend-only, but run once at the end to confirm no regression). Dev servers (next dev / uvicorn) are BLOCKED by a sandbox guard — DO NOT launch them. The immersive landing relies on runtime browser APIs (canvas, <video>, requestAnimationFrame) + remote CORS media that only truly render in a real browser; here verify via static review against the spec acceptance checklist, HTML/JS validity, successful build, and clean lint. Call out browser-only items in the handback.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. next build output (.next/) is gitignored.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in frontend/node_modules and backend venv. If node_modules is missing: cd frontend && npm ci. Backend: cd backend && uv sync.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET at build time (remote mixkit/pexels asset URLs reachable), BUT no browser/display here so canvas/video/cursor cannot be visually verified — only static + build verification. Live dev servers blocked. The self-contained landing HTML must use ZERO external JS/CSS libraries per the spec.
contribution_requirements: Keep all four gates green (frontend lint+vitest+build, backend ruff+pytest). Do NOT push or open PRs — orchestrator publishes. Preserve live-data wiring on all dashboard pages and the working login/auth flow. Never use em dashes in code comments or docs.
key_patterns: Design tokens are the single source of truth across THREE files that must stay mutually consistent: frontend/tailwind.config.ts (color scales + boxShadow + backgroundImage), frontend/app/globals.css (CSS variables + @layer base/components), frontend/lib/theme.ts (palette export + navItems nav model + brand). Existing alpine palette: forest/mist/pine/dawn/sky/slate/alert scales. UI primitives in frontend/components/ui/{Card,Button,Badge,StatTile,Table,PageHeader}.tsx use cn() from lib/cn.ts and Tailwind classes. Layout in frontend/components/layout/{AppShell,Sidebar,Header}.tsx. Dashboard pages live in app/(dashboard)/ route group, gated by SessionGate (redirects to /login if no token) wrapping AppShell. Pages are LIVE-first via lib/api.ts (useLiveData hook) with LoadState load/empty/error states — do NOT regress this. Login page at app/login/page.tsx (server component shell) renders components/auth/LoginForm.tsx (client). Fonts wired in app/layout.tsx via next/font (Inter --font-sans, Poppins --font-display).
